title: Gemini Decisions API: Fast, calibrated multimodal decisions

beats.text: Google DeepMind just dropped the Gemini Decisions API, a dedicated new way to handle high-stakes logic for your applications.
beats.visual_focus: Hero announcement card with Google DeepMind emblem.

visual_blueprint.title: GEMINI DECISIONS API: FAST, CALIBRATED MULTIMODAL DECISIONS
visual_blueprint.sub: Hero announcement card with Google DeepMind emblem.

motif_params.title: GEMINI DECISIONS API: FAST, CALIBRATED MULTIMODAL DECISIONS
motif_params.sub: Hero announcement card with Google DeepMind emblem.

beats.text: If you are building AI agents, you know that raw generation isn't enough; you need calibrated, reliable choices that don't fluctuate wildly when the input changes. It is like moving from one checkout line to an express lane: the job is the same, but the wait changes.
beats.visual_focus: Split screen showing erratic vs. calibrated AI output lines.

visual_blueprint.title: THE RELIABILITY GAP
visual_blueprint.sub: Split screen showing erratic vs. calibrated AI output lines.

motif_params.title: THE RELIABILITY GAP
motif_params.sub: Split screen showing erratic vs. calibrated AI output lines.

beats.text: The new Gemini Decision model is specifically engineered to provide fast, calibrated multimodal decisions, acting as the brain for your complex automated workflows.
beats.visual_focus: Motion graphic showing data streams funneling into a decision node.

visual_blueprint.title: MULTIMODAL LOGIC
visual_blueprint.sub: Motion graphic showing data streams funneling into a decision nod

motif_params.title: MULTIMODAL LOGIC
motif_params.sub: Motion graphic showing data streams funneling into a decision nod

beats.text: While Google hasn't shared specific public benchmarks or speed-up metrics just yet, the focus here is clearly on the precision of the decision-making process.
beats.visual_focus: Text overlay stating 'Benchmarks: Not Reported' inside a sleek box.

visual_blueprint.title: TRANSPARENCY CHECK
visual_blueprint.sub: Text overlay stating 'Benchmarks: Not Reported' inside a sleek bo

motif_params.title: TRANSPARENCY CHECK
motif_params.sub: Text overlay stating 'Benchmarks: Not Reported' inside a sleek bo

beats.text: Right now, this functionality is officially available through the API tier, though specific pricing details were not included in the initial launch announcement.
